PLAYER · CONNECTIONS
Metadata settings
Optional movie and show details. Your local library and playback work without an internet connection.
When enabled, opening a title can load its details and artwork. Player sends only a normalized title, year when known, and media type. Unclear matches are never guessed.
Allow TMDB metadata
When enabled, Player sends normalized titles, year when known and movie/show type directly to api.themoviedb.org, then fetches artwork from image.tmdb.org. TMDB can see your network IP address.
Your videos, subtitles, folder names, file paths and original filenames stay on your device. Disabling metadata keeps your local library available.
Read access token saved
Your TMDB connection
Use your own TMDB API Read Access Token. Player encrypts it on this device and excludes it from app backup.
Player’s shared TMDB connection is available. It is a public app credential and can be extracted from the APK. Requests start only after you enable metadata.
The shared TMDB connection is not configured for this build yet. Player does not ask each person for a token; your local library and playback continue to work offline.
This install has an older locally saved TMDB token. Its previous consent can remain active until you turn metadata off. You can also remove that saved token below.
